mapper.sql: message_id, conversation_id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_msg_id, content_type, content, ref_post_id, is_read, read_time, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into mall_chat_message (conversation_id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_msg_id, content_type, content, ref_post_id, is_read, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{recipientId}, #{clientMsgId}, #{contentType}, #{content}, #{refPostId}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update mall_chat_message set is_read = 1, read_time = now() where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and recipient_id = #{recipientId} and is_read = 0
